verdict.rationale: x402 supports amount-scoped authorization via the 'upto' scheme and cryptographically signed vouchers/escrow with defined limits and refund semantics (docs-8, docs-24, supp-10), and agentic accounts let an agent hold and spend a funding source (docs-11, supp-7) — this covers the 'amount limits' piece of a scoped credential. However there is no evidence of expiry-based credentials or merchant/counterparty restrictions on a payment credential, and the mechanism is a crypto wallet/authorization signature rather than a discrete revocable credential object analogous to a virtual card. Missing for 10: expiry-limited credentials, merchant-restriction scoping, and any card-like scoped-credential issuance/management UI.
